services.title: Shingle Roof Installation
services.short: A new shingle roof, installed by a crew that has done it for over 20 years.
services.text: Shingles are one of the most common roofing materials, and a low-maintenance roof that stands up to the weather. We install them with the right materials and techniques, so water stays out. Veteran Roofing Construction has installed them for over 20 years.
services.imageAlt: A person in work gloves using a cordless drill on a wooden roof deck
body: Choosing the right shingle roof installation contractor matters. Improper installation can result in water infiltration, flagging or other problems that could lead to serious structural damage, so we use proper roofing materials and techniques on every roof.

We ask that the roof is looked over thoroughly before work starts, so any potential problems are corrected before they become major issues. Before you decide, ask our team about all the options available and how they might fit into your overall home plans.

We know roof installation. We have been doing it for over 20 years, and our team of experts is dedicated to providing the highest quality service possible. We use the latest technology and equipment to install your roof quickly and correctly. Veteran Roofing Construction also offers a 100% satisfaction guarantee on all our work, so you can be sure you are getting the best possible service.
points: A thorough inspection of the roof before work starts
Proper roofing materials and techniques on every job
The latest technology and equipment
A free estimate on all of our services
100% satisfaction guarantee on all our work

faqs.q: What are the benefits of a shingle roof?
faqs.a: A shingle roof is low maintenance and weatherproof. It reduces energy costs by absorbing solar and wind energy, and it has a higher insulation value than a traditional roof, so it keeps your home warmer in the winter and cooler in the summer.

faqs.q: What if I am not happy with the work?
faqs.a: We offer a 100% satisfaction guarantee on all our work. If, for any reason, you are not happy with our work, please let us know, and we will do everything we can to make things right.

services.title: Shingle Roof Repair
services.short: Worn and damaged shingles put right, including storm and hail damage.
services.text: If your shingle roof is starting to show signs of wear and tear, or is not performing as well as it used to, it is important to get it fixed as soon as possible. We also specialize in repairing damage from storms and hail.
services.imageAlt: A dormer window set into a shingled roof
body: A shingle roof repair works by first peeling away the damaged shingles and replacing them. The new ones go on in an overlapping pattern and are fixed into place, so the roof sheds water the way it is meant to.

One of the most common repairs is when water gets behind the tiles and through the gaps between them. That damaged area only needs to be sealed. If we think the roof needs more extensive work than that, we will tell you.

Repairing a roof can be cost-effective when the damage is limited and correctable. If a roof needs to be replaced because of extensive damage, replacing it may be the better option, and we will say which we think it is before you spend anything. At Veteran Roofing Construction we specialize in shingle roof repair and can help you get your home back to normal as quickly and efficiently as possible.
points: Damaged and worn shingles replaced
Leaks sealed where water gets behind the shingles
Storm and hail damage repair
An honest answer on repair against replacement
A free estimate before any work starts

faqs.q: Should I repair my roof or replace it?
faqs.a: There are pros and cons to both. Repairing is generally cheaper and makes sense when the damage is limited and correctable. If the damage is extensive, replacing the whole roof may be the better option. We look at the roof and tell you which it is.

faqs.q: When should I call about a repair?
faqs.a: As soon as you notice your shingle roof showing signs of wear and tear, or not performing as well as it used to. Problems with roofs can often be fixed by a professional, but they can also lead to more serious damage if they are not corrected on time.

services.title: Roof Washing
services.short: Dirt, moss, algae and stains washed off without damaging the roof.
services.text: Roof washing removes dirt, dust, pollen, debris and other allergens from your roof. We have the expertise and equipment to clean your roof without damaging it.
services.imageAlt: Moss growing across the tiles of a roof
body: At Veteran Roofing Construction we have the expertise and equipment to clean your roof without damaging it. A roof washing service uses high-pressure water and specialized equipment to clean your roof quickly and efficiently, and it removes any moss, algae or lichen that has formed on the surface. A thorough clean also takes off mold and mildew.
We provide a stain removal service where one is needed, to get rid of unwanted stains that have developed over time.

We are a family-owned and operated business with over 20 years of experience in roof washing. Our crews are highly experienced and trained, we use state-of-the-art equipment, and we have a large selection of safe, eco-friendly products.
points: High-pressure water and specialized equipment
Moss, algae and lichen removed
Stain removal where it is needed
Safe, eco-friendly products
Cleaned without damage to the roof

faqs.q: Why have the roof washed at all?
faqs.a: It removes dirt, dust, pollen and other allergens, and it disinfects the roofing materials and improves their lifespan. A roof that is not properly cleaned also lets rain do damage to the rest of the house.

services.title: Commercial Roof Installation
services.short: Flat, pitched and gable roofs for buildings of any size.
services.text: Commercial roofs are larger and more complex than residential ones, and need different materials and an additional layer of insulation. We install asphalt and metal roofs on commercial buildings.
services.imageAlt: The grey metal roof of a large commercial building against a cloudy sky
body: A commercial roof installation typically involves installing an asphalt or metal roof over a structure such as a building or a carport. It often needs a lift truck and a ladder truck as well as a range of other tools, and it needs experience to avoid mistakes during the process.

There are several kinds of commercial roof installation. Flat roofs are the most common, simple to install and maintain, and used for storage facilities, restaurants, hotels, convention centers and factories. Pitched roofs have a more pronounced slope and are often used for warehouses and other industrial facilities. Gable roofs have two slopes meeting in the middle, and flat-gabled roofs are the same but with one side higher than the other.

At Veteran Roofing Construction we have years of experience in this field. Our approach works for businesses of all sizes. We work closely with you throughout the process to make sure the installation meets your specific needs and expectations, and we are always willing to answer any questions you may have.
points: Asphalt and metal commercial roofs
Flat, pitched, gable and flat-gabled roofs
An additional layer of insulation
A written estimate for materials and labor
100% satisfaction guarantee on all of our work

faqs.q: How is a commercial roof different from a house roof?
faqs.a: Commercial roofs are typically larger and have more complex shapes and construction than residential roofs, so they take a different type of roofing material, an additional layer of insulation, and more specialized installation methods.

faqs.q: Can I get an estimate first?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team can provide you with an accurate estimate for the materials and labor needed to install your new roof, free of charge.

about.title: Veteran owned, family owned, and over 20 years on roofs
text: Veteran Roofing Construction is a veteran-owned and operated roofing company. We have over 20 years of experience in the roofing industry, and our team of professionals is passionate about their work.

Veteran Roofing Construction in Liberty is a family-owned and operated business that has been providing quality roofing services to the area. We are licensed, insured and certified professionals who take pride in our workmanship and attention to detail.

We believe in providing our clients with the best quality roofing possible, whether through our knowledge and expertise in roofing construction or through the personal service we offer. We take pride in always putting our clients first, and we will go out of our way to deliver a top-quality product on time and at a price you can afford.

Veteran roofing contractors understand the importance of providing quality construction services to military members and their families. We take our obligations seriously and make sure that every project we work on is completed to the highest possible standards.
